title: Construction of an absolutely integrally closed extension that is free as a module
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs, for an arbitrary ring, an extension that is a filtered colimit of finite free algebras, is free as a module and is absolutely integrally closed, and the proof is a 23-line construction. It defines an endofunctor of the category of rings by adjoining a formal root of every monic polynomial, observes that it is free and a filtered colimit of finite free algebras, and then takes the colimit of the resulting sequence; any monic polynomial over the colimit has coefficients in some finite stage and therefore acquires a root at the next stage, which makes the colimit absolutely integrally closed. The functor and the colimit argument are displayed, and the remaining properties are declared to be left to the reader.
